## 2 · Assess
Starts when a vendor submits the form. Checks the **SECP** company register and the **UN** sanctions list, runs three web searches, and has the AI score the vendor against the policy Google Doc. Hard rules are applied in code, the result is saved to **ebm_vendors**, and the approver gets an email.
